ploidyspec report: drRosCani1

Summary

Structure in this individual's assembly, read from the sections below; not inheritance and not origin. See docs/guide, Chapter 6.

Ploidy

5 haplotype copies of each of 7 chromosome numbers (HAP1B, HAP1C, HAP1D split out of one haplotype file holding two chromosome sets); an odd copy number (triploid-like or higher odd ploidy); no older duplicated sets detected.

Confidence: high. Evidence: copies from the assembly (5 per number); extra set(s) matched one-to-one to the shared numbers

Auto-like or allo-like?

Allo-like (disomic-like): most chromosomes split into two lineages. A long-rediploidized autopolyploid would look the same.

Confidence: high. Evidence: 7 chromosome numbers assessed: 7 split into lineages, 0 tetrasomic-like, 0 one divergent copy, 0 candidate

TE markers

Repeat history tracks the lineages on several chromosomes: separate TE histories in the split copies.

Confidence: medium. Evidence: TE split >= 2 on 1/7 chromosomes (median 1.83); absolute te_marker_fraction 0.3965 (reference only)

Rediploidization

Split throughout: either rediploidization is complete or the genome was allo-like from the start; these data cannot tell which.

Confidence: medium. Evidence: 7 split / 0 tetrasomic-like chromosomes; 0 regional split(s); homeology map: 0% of the genome in 0 homeolog blocks, 0 chromosome pairs

Copy number and copy divergence (whole-chromosome matrix)

Hierarchically reordered, chromosome-number resolution

Same distance data as the heatmaps above, but collapsed to one value per chromosome NUMBER (haplotype copies aggregated away) and reordered by average-linkage clustering -- shows cross-chromosome (subgenome/ancestral-pair) structure cleanly, including diffuse structure with no individually FDR-significant pair. Red outlines mark individually FDR-accepted pairs from the homeolog test below. See INTERPRETATION.md's "checkerboard" section.
